decision.chosen: A (thin adapter over the existing volume channel)
decision.reason: RENDER_FIELDS has 116 specs without any hfield field and src/model/render.rs is a 500-line redline file, while VolumeModelInput (G1/G10 chain) already exposes hfield_data()/hfield_size()/hfield_size_f32()/ints(hfield_nrow,ncol,adr) and validates lengths/ranges in new()
decision.rejected_b_cost: split src/model/render.rs (500 -> ~382) + new src/model/render/fields.rs (~126); CountUnit +2; RenderModelCounts +2; RENDER_FIELDS 116->121 (append ids 116-120); io/render.rs count/static assertions +8-12; native model_probe_render.cpp render_stage 5 cases + mjwarp_render_info +2 fields (native ABI change, re-freeze); RenderModelCounts::validate +2; sync all tests/evidence hard-coding 116; ~10 files, +40-60 lines, touches redline and native ABI

files.content: VolumeHfieldInputs adapter: from_volume / as_inputs / resolve; no data copy, no nworld read, NativeProbeError passthrough
#[path = "hfield_inputs.rs"] pub mod hfield_inputs; mount + doc note
7 host tests: adapt, full chain, no-hfield None, G10 fixture array match, single f64->f32 conversion, boundary semantics, stable-and-copy-free
module source registration 35 -> 36 and fingerprint refresh via normify done

api.top_level_export_note: render/mod.rs is outside this card's scope and was not modified; S2 can add a one-line top-level re-export if needed

semantic_notes: size is the only f64->f32 conversion point (model::volume::num_to_f32, hfield_size_f32), no second conversion
data is borrowed, not copied (test asserts pointer equality against model.hfield_data())
single copy: the adapter takes no nworld and the view count equals nhfield

boundary semantics differ by layer: volume construction accepts nrow=0 (>=0 check) while S1 resolve rejects <=0 with NonPositiveRowsCols; the test verifies that edge explicitly instead of silently rewriting it

tests.fixture: fixtures/g10-p5/hfield-f32/hfield-box-cpu.json model.arrays (input-consistency only, no rendering numeric conclusion)

uncovered: product path: who provides VolumeModelInput when creating the render context is left to S2 (interface decision)
device-side hfield BVH and kernel intersection not implemented (S2); hfield_bvh_id slot semantics unchanged
no upstream 2D numeric/equivalence verification; input consistency only
CollisionInputs channel not used in this slice (VolumeModelInput covers the need)
